correctness.rationale: For W_(n+1)=K1 vee C_n, hub-free forts are complements of maximal independent cyclic rim sets (gaps 2,3). Hub-including minimal forts have selected rim gap lengths 1,2,3 with neighboring sums >=4 and at least one 3, ensuring rim and hub essential. Weighted cyclic transfer T with det(I-zT)=1-zu^2-zu^3-z^2u^4+z^3u^6 yields both claimed logarithmic-derivative rational generating functions and the hub sequence. Independent direct minimal-fort enumeration n=3..9 corroborates all sizes, not an infinite proof.
residual_risks: Bounded finite experiments do not prove unrestricted quantification; proof reconstruction includes stated critical lemmas.
